# x-tweet-fetcher

> x-tweet-fetcher (`xtf`) is a Python CLI and library that lets AI agents and developers fetch X/Twitter tweets, replies, timelines, search results, Lists and X Articles without logging in or using the X API. 免登录、免 API key 抓取 X（推特）内容。

- Read-only. Stdlib-only Python (3.10+), MIT license. Not published on PyPI.
- Backends with automatic fallback: FxTwitter (single tweets, profiles), Nitter (timelines, search, replies, mentions, Lists; plain HTTP), browser driver (Camofox or Playwright; X Articles, and fallback for timelines, replies, mentions and Lists).
- Lists: Nitter first, browser fallback. Articles: browser only.
- Output is one unified JSON schema (Tweet / Reply / Profile / Article).
- Errors carry `error_code`: `invalid_input`, `not_found`, `rate_limited`, `upstream_down`, `backend_unavailable`, `all_backends_failed` (with per-backend `error_causes`).
- Optional local SQLite archive: `--ledger <db>`, then `--query` / `--stats` offline.

## Install

    pip install git+https://github.com/ythx-101/x-tweet-fetcher

## Minimal usage

    xtf --url https://x.com/user/status/1234567890
    export XTF_NITTER=http://127.0.0.1:8788
    xtf --user someuser --limit 20
    xtf --search "query" --limit 10
    xtf --list 1455045069516357634
    xtf --article https://x.com/i/article/2011779830157557760

## Configuration (environment variables)

- `XTF_NITTER`: comma-separated Nitter instances, tried in order (default `http://127.0.0.1:8788`)
- `XTF_BROWSER`: `camofox` (default) or `playwright`
- `XTF_BROWSER_PORT`: Camofox HTTP port (default `9377`)
- `XTF_LANG`: message language, `zh` (default) or `en`
